How the score works

Within a 600 m straight-line radius, SiteBuddy describes retail variety, everyday amenities, and proximity to a mapped bus, tram, or rail stop. Each dimension is scored on a simple published rubric and contributes equally. The score is withheld unless all three dimensions have usable observations.

The rubric is illustrative and uncalibrated. It favors mixed-use, transit-served places and may not suit car-oriented, rural, or destination locations. It measures mapped context, not commercial success.
